_note: One-minute Pip & Willow episodes for the nightly cloud run, in order. Each has 8 shots; every shot is one simple, gentle movement, because video models fail on complex action. Pip = male (notched LEFT ear, mustard scarf). Willow = female (flower behind RIGHT ear, cream heart patch). 'cast' says who is in frame so the still prompt only asks for who is there.
